scheme_name: Dental Care Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Worker must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Worker must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Service period is fixed for one year
Application must be submitted within three months of the dentist's prescription or bill
Beneficiary should not have availed the benefit of this scheme earlier
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹4,000 for dental care and up to ₹10,000 for full denture fixation for workers and their dependents.
